title: Numbers 21–30
introduction: Explore numbers 21 to 30. Look at the numeral, say its name and count the dots on each card. This is supplementary preschool practice.
definition: Numbers 21 to 30 can be counted one at a time or in groups of ten and extra ones. A complete outlined group contains ten dots.
rules: Point to each dot once as you count.
Say the number name and match it to the numeral.
Count each complete group as ten, then count any remaining dots.

examples.question: Write 30 in words.
steps: Read the number name beneath the dots.

examples.question: How many dots are in 3 full groups of ten?
steps: Count ten for each full group.

summary: Recognise, name and count numbers 21 to 30.
